chunks: He says: "I have wasted a great deal of wealth."

key_terms.لُبَدًا: a great deal, a large quantity, much

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to have wasted a great deal of wealth in Islamic ethical teachings?
ai.summary: This phrase, often cited in Shia exegetical traditions regarding the regret of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment, captures the moment of irreversible loss where one realizes their wealth was consumed like a 'lubad' (a clump of earth or dust). It underscores the transient nature of material possessions and serves as a warning against hoarding and squandering resources in heedlessness of the Hereafter.
